F to 1

Frequency once per 10 minutes

You've achieved near-perfect integration with your augmentations, allowing you to react with uncanny speed and precision. Activate an augmentation currently installed in your body. If the augmentation would usually take 1 action to Activate, Modification Synchronization is a free action. If the augmentation would usually take 2 actions to Activate, Modification Synchronization is 1 action. For example, Activating a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Dragon Gland (Commercial)]{Commercial Dragon Gland} to Exhale would be a free action, while Activating @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Psychoactive Eyes (Commercial)]{Commercial Psychoactive Eyes} to Gaze would be 1 action.
